answer: Each identity must post a bond at the wharf registry before it can transact, and the registry admits one credential per hardware module. Registering a fake identity locks 500 tokens for 30 epochs, and proven fraud slashes 100% of the bond. Splitting into many identities raises the marginal cost per fake to the full bond and invites detection by independent jurors, so copying identities cannot reach the summit or the horizon of profitable scale.
